scope: Independent formal validation of explicit power-of-two ROB modulo distance and valid-gated oldest selection with unmodified arbitrary-age payloads for invalid leaves. Extracted verbatim from the private fast-age core; excludes unrelated owner-column changes and does not claim full-CPU performance/timing equivalence.

distance_and_counter_proof.scope: All valid positions, recovery ages through capacity inclusive, both keep/recovering values, and all legal queue-count increments/decrements.
distance_and_counter_proof.formula_source: distance(), killed(), and static CSB age assignment extracted verbatim from core.sv; counters checked against the current declarations.

oldest_macro_proof.scope: Exact actual macro signed integer result versus strict serial argmin, for all valid/age inputs

proof_inputs.oldest_macro_source:
`define CPU_OLDEST_FUNCTION(NAME, N, LIMIT) \
  function automatic integer NAME(input logic [(N)-1:0] valid, \
      input logic [(N)*(RW+1)-1:0] ages); \
    localparam integer LEAVES=1<<$clog2(N), INDEX_BITS=((N)>1 ? $clog2(N):1); \
    logic [2*LEAVES-1:1] tree_valid; \
    logic [RW:0] tree_age [2*LEAVES-1:1]; \
    logic [INDEX_BITS-1:0] tree_index [2*LEAVES-1:1]; \
    logic left_wins; \
    begin \
      NAME=-1;left_wins=0; \
      if(|valid) begin \
        for(integer n=0;n<LEAVES;n=n+1) begin \
          tree_valid[LEAVES+n]=0;tree_age[LEAVES+n]=0;tree_index[LEAVES+n]=0; \
          if(n<(N)) begin \
            tree_valid[LEAVES+n]=valid[n] && ages[n*(RW+1)+:RW+1]<(RW+1)'(LIMIT); \
            tree_age[LEAVES+n]=ages[n*(RW+1)+:RW+1]; \
            tree_index[LEAVES+n]=INDEX_BITS'(n); \
          end \
        end \
        for(integer n=LEAVES-1;n>0;n=n-1) begin \
          left_wins=tree_valid[2*n] && (!tree_valid[2*n+1] || tree_age[2*n]<=tree_age[2*n+1]); \
          tree_valid[n]=tree_valid[2*n] || tree_valid[2*n+1]; \
          tree_age[n]=left_wins ? tree_age[2*n]:tree_age[2*n+1]; \
          tree_index[n]=left_wins ? tree_index[2*n]:tree_index[2*n+1]; \
        end \
        if(tree_valid[1]) NAME=int'(tree_index[1]); \
      end \
    end \
  endfunction
proof_inputs.age_yosys_script_template:
read_slang --top age_equivalence -G N=CAPACITY age_equivalence.sv
opt -full
wreduce
opt -full
sat -verify -prove equivalent 1 -show-inputs -show-outputs -timeout 30

reproduction.age: Save proof_inputs.age_harness_source as age_equivalence.sv and substitute each recorded capacity in age_yosys_script_template; alternatively run prove_ages.py --core on the recorded candidate source.
reproduction.oldest: Save proof_inputs.oldest_macro_source as a .svh file, then run prove_oldest_selection.py --source FILE --timeout 60 with cases1:1:1 and N:6:LIMIT for N in1,4,5,21,24,68 and LIMIT in32,33.

mutations: No candidate or production RTL changes; report only.
